headline.text: L3 ML4 ripped belt caught before production — *fiber contamination* concern resolved with replacement, gum found on motor.

summary: One high-severity event: ripped M270 belt on ML4 TG4C12 posed fiber contamination risk — caught during cleaning, replaced before restart. Gum found on ML4 motor removed immediately. Truffle Line scrapers need replacement.

food_safety.title: Ripped belt on TG4C12 posed fiber contamination risk
food_safety.summary: M270 belt discovered with center rip during 2nd shift cleaning; concern raised about fibers transferring to chocolate bars; belt replaced before production restart.
food_safety.status: Resolved — belt replaced by maintenance at 20:00 MT; production ready.

quality.title: Worn scrapers causing belt drift and sealing issues on Truffle Line
quality.summary: C4 and C3 scrapers worn; chocolate buildup on rollers triggered five belt-shift alarms and contributed to Cavanna 1 rail buildup affecting flow wrap sealing quality.
quality.status: Open — scrapers replacement needed; line CILT cleaning performed, production ready for Monday.

quality.title: Damaged 35g mold identified on ML1
quality.summary: One 35g mold found damaged during 2nd shift mold installation; removed from service.

sanitation.title: Chewing gum attached to M307 motor
sanitation.summary: Gum found stuck to M307 motor on ML4 during 2nd shift cleaning; hygiene violation in production area.

opportunities.text: Consider adding conveyor belt inspection to ML4 startup checklist — based on today's ripped M270 belt that posed fiber contamination risk before discovery during cleaning.
Review scraper replacement schedule for Truffle Line C3/C4 conveyors — based on worn scrapers causing five belt-shift alarms and chocolate buildup affecting sealing quality today.
